newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux says 1 share to give 0.5 Granges share.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux says 1 share to give 0.5 Granges share.

text.p: Swedish household appliance group Electrolux AB said on Thursday that every one share in Electrolux would give half a share in its aluminium subsidiary Granges, which the company plans to spin off.
Granges will be listed on the Stockholm Stock Exchange on May 21, Electrolux said in a statement.
The spin-off is expected to reduce Electrolux's equity by 1.78 billion crowns and debt by 3.80 billion crowns but the debt-to-equity ratio will be unchanged, the company said in a statement.
The balance sheet total will fall by 5.58 billion crowns, Electrolux said.
Shareholders are due to meet on April 29 to decide on the spin-off plan.
On May 15, the Electrolux share will start trading excluding rights to Granges shares, the company said.
The spin-off will not include the Recycling business area, which will be transferred to Electrolux, the company said.
